background_notes.fact: For each fixed real time, S is an isometry on H^s, P is a contraction, and Dinv:H^s->H^(s+1) and Dinv2:H^s->H^(s+2) are bounded. H^r embeds continuously in H^s for r>=s. The scalar map (f,g)->P0(fg) is bounded L2 x L2->C. Together with N005's H1 product estimate these operations make each expression in D009–D011 continuous on the mean-zero L2 domain for each fixed tau>0; any fixed finite iterate is continuous.

background_notes.justification: Compare the weighted Fourier sums: (1+k^2)/k^2<=2 for nonzero integer k; the twice-inverse bound follows by composition, and deleting a mode decreases the norm. The embedding follows from the weights. Cauchy–Schwarz gives |P0(fg)|<=||f||2||g||2. A bounded bilinear map is continuous by expanding B(x,y)-B(x0,y0) as B(x-x0,y)+B(x0,y-y0). Finite sums and compositions of these continuous maps are continuous. Applying this to the four displayed Htau terms and Ftau proves the claimed continuity; finite composition proves continuity of every trajectory coordinate.

background_notes.justification: Each multiplier m satisfies m(-k)=conj(m(k)); the constant mode is real for real data, and products of real functions are real. The claimed zero modes follow directly from projection or the vanishing inverse-derivative mode. Smooth periodic functions have rapidly decreasing Fourier coefficients by repeated integration by parts; multiplication by these bounded multipliers preserves rapid decrease and hence smoothness by absolute convergence of every differentiated Fourier series. Finite products are smooth by the product rule. These facts apply term by term in the update.

background_notes.justification: The bound |eta|<=2 and |1/k|<=1 at nonzero integer k bound every weighted absolute output sum by a constant times products of weighted absolute input sums: use 1+|a+b+c|<= (1+|a|)(1+|b|)(1+|c|). These sums are finite for rapidly decreasing smooth input coefficients. Thus every spatial derivative series converges absolutely and Rem is smooth. Under simultaneous sign reversal of a,b,c,k, alpha,beta,Phi change sign, eta becomes its complex conjugate, the exponential becomes its conjugate, and the factor -tau/(18ik) also becomes its conjugate. The summation constraint is invariant and real input coefficients conjugate under reversal. Absolute convergence therefore gives output conjugate symmetry. The zero coefficient is zero by definition.

background_notes.justification: For smooth inputs, arbitrary spatial and time derivatives of S_t Fourier series converge uniformly on compact time intervals because each time derivative introduces only a polynomial factor k^(3j). Products and spatial derivatives preserve smoothness; successive integrals of these smooth functions are smooth by the fundamental theorem of calculus, with differentiation in space justified by uniform derivative convergence on the compact interval. B_t has zero mean because its spatial derivative has zero constant coefficient, and is real by the multiplier symmetry. Its stage integrals and the affine combination in Vst therefore remain real and mean-zero, including the fixed remainder from BG003. On a finite partition, continuity inside each piece and equality of the two one-sided endpoint values prove continuity of the glued path; smoothness on each piece gives piecewise smoothness.
